name: reviewer-v1.3
description: Split manifest for Reviewer-LoRA v1.3 training. Extends v1.2 with required ## Patch comparison sections in all source-backport reviews (both positives and negatives), addressing the v1.2 gate failure where the model hallucinated patch content without reading actual +/- lines.

sqlite.reason: sqlite (CVE-2022-46908) was in dev under hash-based assignment (bucket=72). LoRA v1.0 false-rejected this example, hallucinating a wrong UNUSED_PARAMETER direction. Moving to train so the model sees the correct positive during training. Carried forward from v1.1 and v1.2.

note: v1.3 adds ## Patch comparison sections (reviewer.v5.md output shape) to: (a) all 8 source-backport negatives (reversed-hunk x2, missing-hunk x2, partial-hunk x2, extra-unrelated-hunk x2); (b) all 19 train-split source-backport positives. Also adds pyjwt as a new genuine reject negative (v5 reviewer correctly identified missing empty-key guard hunk that v4 missed). reviewer.v5.md is the system prompt for v1.3 training.
